What these captures establish

Both models use the game’s procedural builder and materials. Each pair shares a bounding box, orthographic camera and studio lights. This isolates geometry and color from the moving game environment. The silhouette view removes surface color and outlines. In-game lighting, bloom and perspective will look different.

Build and browser verification are recorded with this review. These are not frame-rate measurements or a claim of photographic accuracy. The remaining original hulls are identified honestly; they have no asserted SG-1 counterpart.

Reference stills: Stargate SG-1, reproduced from Richard Dean Anderson’s Lexicon for this private comparison; linked individually above. No downloaded models or asset packs were used.

Choices stay in this browser. Nothing is applied to the game.
All previous hull data remains in the source. The original-fleet link restores it for play.
